'''Nerf steaks''' were the meat of a [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]]. Each steak usually weighed half a kilo. They were served in different types of meals at breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

Nerf steaks were served in several dishes at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]. For breakfast, grilled nerf steak seasoned with a unique blend of [[serrian salt]], [[tertium]], [[Punctil]], and [[black hole pepper]] and served with two [[gartro]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] was on sale, it cost 12.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was considered a staple throughout the galaxy. A variation of this was [[Quor'sav-fried steak]]. For lunch, [[nerfsteak sandwich]] was available for 8.7 credits, and finally for dinner meals, fried nerf steak with melted [[jerba cheese]], grilled [[Ojomian onion]]s, and [[Felucian glasscap mushroom]]s was available for 14.7 credits.

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] longed to eat a nerf steak after spending a very long mission in the confines of her [[StealthX]].

Nerf steaks were one of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] kept in the galley of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. When [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Nashtah]] was aboard with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], she demanded four raw steaks. Instead of eating them however, she extracted the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] into a glass and drank it.<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>

Nerf steak was also used to make [[nerf steak stew]].<ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>
